senses.gloss: ch. sameto improve, rise in value; to make profit.
units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 140a:2">B. Bath. 140ᵃ</cite> <he>ברשות יורשין שְׁבוּחַ</he> they rose in value while in the possession of the heirs (and the benefit ought to be theirs).
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 98a:2">B. Kam. 98ᵃ</cite>, v. <he>נִסְבָּא</he> II; a. e.

<cite ref="Gittin 80b:4">Gitt. 80ᵇ</cite> <he>ש׳ להו מילתא</he> it is a matter of praise (an honor) to them (to mention the governor’s name in a document), opp. <cite ref="G00354"><he>זילא</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 4:1">Targ. Ps. IV, 1</cite> <he>לשַׁבָּחָא</he> (h. text <he>למנצח</he>); a. fr.—[<cite ref="Targum Jerusalem, Exodus 34:29">Targ. Y. II, Ex. XXXIV, 29</cite>; <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 149:4">Targ. Ps. CXLIX, 4</cite>, v. <cite ref="U00070"><he>שַׁבְהַר</he></cite>.]—Part. pass. <he>מְשַׁבַּח</he>; f. <he>מְשַׁבַּחְתָּא</he>; pl. <he>מְשַׁבְּחַיָּיא</he>; <cite ref="M02807"><he>מְשַׁבְּחַן</he></cite>. Ib. CXIII, 3.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Ezekiel 26:17">Targ. Ez. XXVI, 17</cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Exodus 15:10">Targ. Y. Ex. XV, 10</cite> <he>מיא ממשבחייא</he>, read: <he>במיא מְשַׁבְּ׳</he> (h. text <he>אדירים</he>).—

<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 3:3">Lam. R. to III, 9</cite> <he>בכל … סליק ש׳ ונחת וכ׳</he> every Friday he went up (to Jerusalem), prayed (in the Temple), and went home and lighted the candles; Y. Maas. Sh. V, 57ᵃ top <cite ref="U00196"><he>שבת</he></cite> (corr. acc.).

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 42a:18">Snh. 42ᵃ</cite> <he>אַשְׁבּוּחֵי מְשַׁבַּח נפשיה</he> (or <he>מַשְׁבַּח</he>) does he proclaim his own praise? <cite ref="Megillah 25b:18">Meg. 25ᵇ</cite> <he>האי … שרי לשַׁבּוּחֵיה ומאן דשֵׁבְּחֵיה וכ׳</he> it is permitted to praise him whose reputation is good, and blessings rest upon the head of him who praises him.

senses.gloss: <cite ref="U00096">same</cite>. Snh. l. c., v. supra.

units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 78:63">Targ. Ps. LXXVIII, 63</cite>; a. e.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Jeremiah 4:2">Targ. Jer. IV, 2</cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Jeremiah 49:4">Ib. XLIX, 4</cite>; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Megillah 11b:5">Meg. 11ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Ezra 1:2">Ezra I, 2</cite>) <he>אִשְׁתַּבּוּחֵי … מִשְׁתַּבַּח בנפשיה</he> it is he (Cyrus) only who thus glorifies himself (as the ruler of all empires).
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 4a:11">Ab. Zar. 4ᵃ</cite> <he>משתבח להו</he> … <he>ברב ספרא וכ׳</he> R. A. recommended RabSafra to the heretics (saying) that he is a great man.

<cite ref="Berakhot 38a">Ber. 38ᵃ</cite> [read:] <he>מִשְׁתַּבְּחִין ליה רבנן בבר וכ׳</he> (Ms. M. <he>משבחין</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) the Rabbis recommended the son of Rab Zabid … (saying) that he is a great man &c.
<cite ref="Pesachim 50b:6">Pes. 50ᵇ</cite> <he>אישתבוחי משתבח בה קרא</he> the Scripture commends her for it.
